name: gloss-browser-extension
description: The Gloss browser extension for immersive page translation through the Gloss macOS app.

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:safari
scripts.check:scripts: for file in extension/*.js scripts/*.js server/*.js tools/*.js tools/perf/*.js test/*.js; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run check:version && npm run check:scripts && node --test test/*.test.js && npm run test:stress
scripts.perf:hyperfine: mkdir -p artifacts/perf && hyperfine --warmup 1 --runs 10 --export-json artifacts/perf/hyperfine.json 'node tools/perf/benchmark.js run --requests 100 --concurrency 16 --items 20 --unique-ratio 0.25 --delay-ms 25 --json >/dev/null'
